BaseInfo.description: The base of a comparison, in the report.

merge_base.description:
The merge base of that commit and `HEAD`, which the comparison reads;
`null` with `--base-exact`, which reads `commit`.

requested.description: The revision asked for, or the default branch used.

BrokenExample.description:
A snippet that resolved at the base and doesn't in the working tree: its
region, file, or source is gone.

address.description: Its address, as the page writes it.

problem.description:
The slug of the diagnostic `ascribe check` reports for it
(`snippet-region-missing`).

reason.description: Why it doesn't resolve, in a few words.

added.description: Lines only in the code now.

address.description: Its address, as the page writes it.

file.description: The code file now, from the repository's root.

removed.description: Lines only in the code at the base.

was_file.description: The code file at the base, when it was renamed since.

DriftPage.description: A page with an example that changed or broke.

broken.description: The examples that resolved at the base and don't now, by address.

builds.description:
The builds that show it with a changed example, in the order asked
for.

examples.description:
The examples that changed, by address. Empty when only `broken`
isn't.

page_changed.description:
Whether the page changed apart from its examples: its own file, or
its resolved content through anything else it uses (a fragment, the
content model), in any of those builds. When it didn't, the example
changed and the words around it didn't.

route.description: Its route, in the first of the builds it's in.

project_prefix.description:
The project's folder inside it, with a trailing `/`, or empty when
the project is at the repository's root.

root.description: The repository's top-level directory, as git prints it.

description: The report, as `ascribe drift --format json` writes it.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

pages.description: Every page with an example that changed or broke, in path order.

title: DriftReport
